messages:
lina: hey folks — getting alerts from CS that 3 customers received overage emails in the last 30m, and the billing dashboard shows a large token spike for eu1. Can oncall pick up? :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: billing.token_count_anomaly (sev P2) — auto-run checks: emitter-heartbeat OK, shadow-aggregator lagging, redis token-bucket steady.
oncall: I'm on. jumping in. what's the observed delta?
lina: not huge in absolute terms (~1.2M tokens over baseline) but the emitter->reconciliation pipeline shows a windowed duplicate in the last 4 writes. CSV of affected customers attached in ticket (CS-7892).
maya: adding logs — saw a retry storm from proxy-emitter at ~13:02 UTC. I filtered for request ids and got this sample: ```
EMITTER_ID=em-4 shard=3 request_id=01FQZX3 log=retry count=5 reason=timeout upstream=token-emitter-v2
EMITTER_ID=em-4 shard=3 request_id=01FQZYA log=retry count=4 reason=timeout upstream=token-emitter-v2
```
kenji: looks like emitter v2 had transient latency -> duplicate ack path. Did we recently roll emitter v2?
samir: yes, rolled v2 to prod eu clusters last night (canary green). But there was an autoscale event this morning that restarted some pods. suspect duplicate ack on replay.
lina: customer impact: 3 invoices flagged but none charged yet — invoice-run is daily at 04:00 UTC. we should stop further overcounting and reconcile before invoice cut.
oncall: immediate plan: 1) pause invoice job (support-bot to hold invoices), 2) switch billing source to shadow-aggregate canonical (reads previously validated ledger), 3) roll emitter v2 back to v1 in eu if we see ongoing retries.
support-bot: Hold requested: invoice-run paused for eu customers (ticket HOLD-112) — confirmed.
maya: I'm rerunning a de-dupe job on the recon pipeline now; ETA ~8m. I'll stream logs to this thread.
incident-bot: Checkpoint results: shadow-aggregator lag = 00:07:12, dedupe-queue depth=420 -> processing.
kenji: can we validate that shadow counts match pre-roll snapshot? If yes, we can use shadow as canonical for tonight's invoice.
samir: snapshot query: ```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM ledger_snapshot WHERE ts < '2026-03-20T12:00:00Z' AND region='eu1';
-- result: 4,312,890 tokens
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM current_agg WHERE window='last-1h' AND region='eu1';
-- result: 5,523,310 tokens
```
kenji: delta ~1.21M which matches the spike. good correlation.
lina: CS asked what to tell customers — short answer: we detected duplicate token counts due to transient emitter retries; no charges posted yet; we're holding invoices and will reconcile within 6 hours.
oncall: rolling emitter v2 back now (eu). will update when podset stable.
maya: dedupe job finished — removed ~1.18M duplicate tokens from the reconciliation view. pushing verification.
incident-bot: Action log: dedupe completed (removed 1,181,112 tokens). emitter-v2 rollback started.
samir: verification queries after dedupe: ```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM reconciled_agg WHERE region='eu1' AND ts >= '2026-03-20T12:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-20T13:00:00Z';
-- result: 4,339,950 tokens
```
kenji: that reconciled number is within noise of the snapshot (+27k) — acceptable. Recommend using reconciled_agg for invoice-run and mark the incident resolved after reconciliation audit.
lina: agree. action items: - CS message template, - postmortem owner, - automated detector tweak to catch emitter retry spikes earlier.
oncall: emitter v2 rollback completed, pods stable, CPU/mem back to baseline.
support-bot: CS notified (ticket CS-7892 update posted). customers told invoices held and fix in progress.
maya: leaving a short grep of the emitter config that caused dup acks: ```
# culprit: aggressive retry window when upstream ack timeout < 500ms
emitter.retry.policy: exponential_backoff
emitter.retry.initial=100ms
emitter.retry.max_attempts=6
# change to: max_attempts=3 for eu rollout
```
samir: noted. will add config change to canary gating and update rollout checklist.
kenji: recommended severity drop to P3 after verification and invoice hold confirmed.
lina: marking incident mitigated — we'll keep thread open for audit but no customer-facing outages. thank you all. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: billing.token_count_anomaly — mitigated, dedupe applied, invoices held. Owner assigned: samir.
kenji: adding postmortem owner samir -> ETA draft 48h.
lina: closing loop: postmortem + follow-up config change + update detectors. I'll post links when ready.
summary: Oncall paged for token-count spike due to emitter retry duplicates; invoices paused, dedupe applied, emitter v2 rolled back in eu, reconciled counts verified, CS notified, postmortem assigned.
